files.patch:
@@ -4,10 +4,12 @@
 version: 1.0
 
 # Debug configuration
+# NOTE: Strict mode is always enabled by default - all parser/lexer errors are reported!
+# RawText fallback NEVER happens silently - parsing failures are always visible.
 debug:
-  parser_errors: true # Report parser errors instead of silently falling back
-  lexer_errors: true # Report lexer errors with details
-  cst_fallback: false # Disable silent RawText fallback on parse failures
+  parser_errors: true # Report parser errors (always enabled)
+  lexer_errors: true # Report lexer errors with details (always enabled)
+  cst_fallback: false # Strict mode - no silent RawText fallback (default: false)
   verbose_tokens: false # Log all tokenization steps (very verbose)
   show_cst_tree: false # Display CST tree structure for debugging

@@ -124,11 +124,13 @@ Options:
   -s, --source=PATH       Source file or directory
   -c, --config=PATH       Config file (default .warp.yaml or warp.yaml)
   -o, --out=DIR           Output directory
+  -f, --format=FORMAT     Inspect output format: pretty|json (default: pretty)
   --rbs=PATH              RBS file to load (repeatable)
   --rbi=PATH              RBI file to load (repeatable)
   --inline-rbs=BOOL       Parse inline # @rbs comments (default true)
   --generate-rbs=BOOL     Generate .rbs signature files (default false)
   --generate-rbi=BOOL     Generate .rbi annotation files (default false)
+  --inspect               Show pipeline internals (source CST, target CST, transformations)
   --parallel=N            Use N parallel workers (default: CPU cores)
   --dry-run               Parse/validate without writing output files
   --stdout                Write output to stdout
@@ -233,13 +235,15 @@ YAML
       dry_run = false
       backend_override : String? = nil
       inspect = false
+      inspect_format : String = "pretty"
 
       parser = OptionParser.new do |p|
         p.banner = transpile_usage
         p.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") { puts transpile_usage; exit 0 }
         p.on("-s PATH", "--source=PATH", "Source file or directory") { |v| source_path = v }
         p.on("-c PATH", "--config=PATH", "Config file (default .warp.yaml)") { |v| config_path = v }
         p.on("-o DIR", "--out=DIR", "Output directory") { |v| out_dir = v }
+        p.on("-f FORMAT", "--format=FORMAT", "Inspect output format: pretty|json (default: pretty)") { |v| inspect_format = v }
         p.on("--rbs=PATH", "RBS file to load (repeatable)") { |v| extra_rbs << v }
         p.on("--rbi=PATH", "RBI file to load (repeatable)") { |v| extra_rbi << v }
         p.on("--inline-rbs=BOOL", "Parse inline # @rbs comments (default true)") { |v| inline_rbs = (v != "false") }

@@ -13,9 +13,11 @@ module Warp
         property diagnostics : Array(String)
 
         def initialize(config : Warp::Lang::Ruby::TranspilerConfig? = nil)
-          @parser_errors = config.try(&.debug_parser_errors?) || false
-          @lexer_errors = config.try(&.debug_lexer_errors?) || false
-          @allow_cst_fallback = config.try(&.debug_cst_fallback?) || true
+          # Always report errors - no silent failures

+          @lexer_errors = true
+          # Strict mode is default - no silent RawText fallbacks
+          @allow_cst_fallback = false
           @verbose_tokens = config.try(&.debug_verbose_tokens?) || false
           @show_cst_tree = config.try(&.debug_show_cst_tree?) || false
           @diagnostics = [] of String
@@ -26,31 +28,25 @@ module Warp
         end
 
         def report_parser_error(message : String, line : Int32 = -1, col : Int32 = -1)
-          if @parser_errors
-            msg = "PARSER ERROR: #{message}"
-            msg += " (line #{line}, col #{col})" if line > -1 && col > -1
-            @diagnostics << msg
-            puts msg
-          end
+          msg = "PARSER ERROR: #{message}"
+          msg += " (line #{line}, col #{col})" if line > -1 && col > -1

         def report_lexer_error(message : String, position : Int32 = -1)
-          if @lexer_errors
-            msg = "LEXER ERROR: #{message}"

-            puts msg

+          msg = "LEXER ERROR: #{message}"
+          msg += " (pos #{position})" if position > -1
+          @diagnostics << msg
+          puts msg
         end
 
         def report_raw_text_fallback(context : String, position : Int32 = -1, token_kind : String = "unknown")
-          unless @allow_cst_fallback

         def report_verbose(message : String)
